evidence.quote: First, we experiment exclusively within the SE domain, using the SWE-bench [11] benchmark. This domain is characterized by long, verbose tool outputs, a condition that naturally favors the efficiency of Observation Masking. Consequently, our findings on the superiority of this strategy may not generalize to domains where agent-environment interactions are more succinct.
Finally, while we provide initial evidence of generalization across agent scaffolds, a more comprehensive investigation may be warranted.

Second, all strategies investigated use simple, non-adaptive heuristic triggers. Observation Masking employs a fixed-size rolling window that is agnostic to the relevance or staleness of past observations (e.g., retaining a file’s content after it was modified). Similarly, LLM-Summary operates on a fixed turn-based schedule, ignoring semantic boundaries or agent subgoals.
